purpose: A versioned catalog of false-pass, identity, tamper, concurrency, execution, and confidentiality probes that Harness v4 must defeat.

cases.assertion: A plan with zero applicable required checks cannot produce any pass verdict.
An applicable required check without an executable capability blocks the run.
An executed assertion that fails cannot be hidden behind an optional flag and promoted to formal success.
Every applicable required command must have exactly one executable graph node and result.
Every validationChecks entry of an applicable required synchronization is compiled into a required execution node.
A Git observation error is never interpreted as an empty change set.
An unresolved or ambiguous base reference blocks candidate construction.
Changing only an index blob changes candidate identity even when worktree bytes and porcelain status remain the same.
A run bound to one commit or tree cannot validate and attest a later commit or tree.
Changing an execution plan after run binding invalidates the run before execution.
Changing the impact or allowed-scope artifact after binding invalidates the run.
Changing a baseline or manifest field without updating a trusted parent digest is detected.
Source-authority or policy drift between planning and audit invalidates evidence.
Unicode, whitespace, rename and special Git paths are parsed losslessly using NUL-delimited output.
Concurrent run creation cannot collide or overwrite another run identity.
Only one live owner with the matching nonce can mutate a leased run.
Evidence from another run or candidate cannot satisfy a result dependency.
A validator that changes candidate source bytes fails even when its command exits zero.
Persisted stdout, stderr, diagnostics and reports contain no credential or secret material.
A mutable unattributed worktree can produce provisional feedback only.
